description: Angular component for configuring alarm schedule settings, including static and dynamic modes, with form validation and control logic.

classes.name: CfAlarmScheduleComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing control value accessor and validator for alarm schedule configuration.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form, subscribes to form value changes, sets up validators.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, updates validators and model accordingly.

methods.name: validateItems
methods.description: Validates that at least one enabled item exists in the schedule items array.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates form with provided AlarmRuleSchedule value.

methods.name: updateModeValidators
methods.description: Enables/disables form controls based on mode.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Sets validators for form controls based on schedule type.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates changes.

methods.name: defaultItemsScheduler
methods.description: Creates default form group for schedule item.

methods.name: changeCustomScheduler
methods.description: Handles selection change for custom scheduler chips.

methods.name: disabledSelectedTime
methods.description: Enables/disables time controls for a schedule item.

methods.name: getSchedulerRangeText
methods.description: Returns formatted text for schedule range.

methods.name: itemsSchedulerForm
methods.description: Getter for schedule items form array.
